title: Efficient Coarse-Grained Free-Energy Computation
exact_target: Compute the free energy per eliminated particle efficiently in the thermodynamic limit of a chain-like atomistic system.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001115 (OWR-2493-001). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Interplay of Analysis and Probability in Physics (2008), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2008/55, pp. 3065--3138; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 9--10, printed pages 3073--3074.

status_qualification: The source already presents a computational strategy for one-dimensional nearest- and next-nearest-neighbor models using Markov-chain and transfer-operator arguments. The broad efficient-computation question lacks an error tolerance and complexity definition; it should not be advertised as having no known method in the source's chain case. This report passage is closely repeated at ID 30001271.
